title: Moe's Agency Alternatives for Meta Ads and Video Creative
summary: Compare Moe's Agency alternatives by scope, published price and terms: creative only, creative plus Meta buying, or a full-service team, as of October 2026.
body_markdown:
## What do the bundled alternatives actually publish?


Brighter Click sells Facebook and Instagram campaign management across feeds, Stories, Reels, Messenger and Audience Network. Management pricing is not published, and every engagement starts with a free audit. Its creator work is a separate, fixed batch: its[UGC agency page](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) lists 12 edited videos from 4 creators for $4,500, delivered in 10 to 14 business days, with unlimited usage rights. That works out to about $375 per edited video by our arithmetic.


Chamber Media is a performance marketing and creative agency in American Fork, Utah. Its homepage FAQ says to expect at least about $5K to $10K a month for creative development, strategy and management, before media. It says campaigns run from your own ad accounts, that clients own those accounts, and the homepage cites one to two week turnarounds.


Top Growth Marketing publishes its fees: $2,000 to $10,000 a month in its FAQ, with a $3,000 low end in its comparison table. Its[homepage](https://topgrowthmarketing.com/) says in-house static, video and UGC creative is included in the monthly fee, with six to eight new hook concepts a month on most accounts. It asks for admin access to your Facebook ad account, Business Manager and catalog, so grant only what you need and review those permissions when the contract ends.


## What budget does each alternative assume?


Budget fit is the second filter, and the published floors differ. Chamber Media says growth is difficult on less than $5K a month in media for local brands, or $15K for national brands. Top Growth Marketing takes DTC ecommerce brands spending $5,000 to $500,000 a month on ads. Pilothouse is built for established DTC ecommerce brands, prices through retainers, performance incentives and custom project scopes, and typically begins onboarding within 5 to 10 business days of signing. It publishes no minimum spend, so ask for the floor in writing.


Agency fees are separate from the money you pay Meta. Meta's[minimum budgets help page](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says Ads Manager requires a minimum budget for each campaign or ad set, which varies by country and objective, and shows an alert when a budget is too low. The minimum is small, but a campaign that barely clears it gives an agency little data to learn from. If your total budget is below the ranges above, a creative-only quote such as Knowlify's is the more natural starting point, while a full-service Meta team with a published minimum may not fit.


## What should you collect before you switch agencies?


A handoff goes better when you have these in hand before the old contract ends:


- **Account roles.** Confirm that your own business owns the ad account, the pixel and the data, and that you hold admin access.
- **Creative files.** Ask for the final ads and the source files, plus the ad names and notes on which concepts won or lost.
- **Test history.** Ask for the list of angles already tested, so the new provider does not repeat them.
- **Billing.** Check the end date, the notice period and any final invoice before you start the new provider.


Meta's Andromeda[engineering post](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) says the number of ad creatives in its recommendation systems is expected to grow significantly as advertisers adopt generative AI tools. With more ads competing, ask each alternative how many distinct concepts it makes a month, separate from resizes and hook swaps, and ask for a sample of the deliverable, not only a description of it.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads, with optional Meta management, but pricing starts at $5,000 a month, so get the billing term and ad count in writing.
- Decide whether you are replacing creative, media buying or both before you compare providers.
- Ask every alternative for distinct concepts per month, not only the number of files.
- Keep admin access and ownership of your ad account and files in your own business, whichever provider you hire.
- Moe's Agency is unrated here because we could not verify its scope or prices, so price the same brief from each provider yourself.


## FAQ


### Why is Moe's Agency not rated in this guide?


We could not verify its published services, prices or contract terms in the sources we checked on October 27, 2026. A rating needs facts you can cite, so we left it out rather than guess. Use the four questions in this guide to compare it with the alternatives.


### Is Knowlify a direct replacement for a Meta ads agency?


Only for part of the job. Knowlify makes finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, about 25 a week, and it can run your Meta campaigns as an option or deliver creative only. It does not supply real human creators, and it does not run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads.


### Who should own the ad account when I switch agencies?


You should. Meta's documentation describes the business that owns an ad account adding an agency with specific permitted tasks, so the account and its history stay yours when the agency changes. Confirm that the new provider has access before the old provider's permissions end.


### How should I compare prices across alternatives?


Send the same brief to each provider: the same number of ads, formats, revision rounds and delivery date, and say whether campaign management is included. Published prices use different units, a monthly fee, a per-video price or a share of spend, so convert each one to the cost of a finished ad you can run.
